sentences.en: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好,这是6分钟英语 从英国广播公司学习英语。

sentences.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Pippa. In this episode we're discussing poetry.
sentences.zh: 我是尼尔,我是皮帕,我们讨论的是诗歌

sentences.en: For some, poetry is what you study at school, then forget, while for others it becomes an important part of their life.
sentences.zh: 对有些人来说,诗歌是你在学校学习的,然后忘记,对其他人来说,诗歌成为他们生活的一个重要部分。

sentences.en: Have you ever read or written any poetry, Neil?
sentences.zh: 你读过或写过诗吗?

sentences.en: Well, I haven't written any poetry since I was at school.
sentences.zh: 我上学后就没写过诗了

sentences.en: I would love to read more poetry, but I just don't get it, really.
sentences.zh: 我很想读更多的诗, 但我只是不明白它,真的。

sentences.en: I find it difficult to understand. A good place to hear poetry is an open mic night, a live event where anyone is allowed to stand up on stage to sing or recite poems.
sentences.zh: 我很难理解。一个听诗歌的好地方是开放的麦克风之夜,一个任何人都可以站起来在舞台上唱歌或朗诵诗歌的现场活动。

sentences.en: Here, BBC reporter Maria recites her open mic poem about a friend who suffered a stroke, for BBC World Service programme People Fixing the World.
sentences.zh: BBC World Service 节目《人们修补世界》,

sentences.en: This first poem, I wrote it about a friend who I love dearly.
sentences.zh: 第一首诗,我写的是关于一个我深爱的朋友

sentences.en: It's called Stroke. You're awake And trying to grasp who it is.
sentences.zh: 这叫"划船" 你醒了 想抓住它是谁

sentences.en: I pull my mask past my lips and you study my face, Eyes wide.
sentences.zh: 我将面具拉过嘴唇 你研究我的脸 睁大眼睛

sentences.en: I've enough stuff to tell you, I say, Sinking into a chair.
sentences.zh: 我有足够的东西告诉你, 我说,沉入椅子。

sentences.en: I stare. Sometimes if you go to an open mic night, people can really touch your soul with what they're saying.
sentences.zh: 有时如果你去一个开放的麦克风之夜 人们会用他们的话来触摸你的灵魂

sentences.en: And even if you're having a bad day, life can feel so much better after going to an open mic night.
sentences.zh: 即使你今天过得不好 参加公开的麦克风之夜 生活也会感觉好很多

sentences.en: For Maria, poetry has the power to heal emotions and touch your soul, meaning to affect you deeply on an emotional or spiritual level.
sentences.zh: 对玛丽亚来说 诗歌有力量治愈感情 抚摸你的灵魂 意味着在情感或精神上深深地影响你

sentences.en: In this episode, we'll hear more about the positive power of poetry and, as usual, we'll learn some useful new words and phrases.
sentences.zh: 在这集中,我们会听到更多关于诗歌的正面力量 和往常一样,我们会学到一些有用的新词句

sentences.en: And remember, you'll find all the vocabulary, plus a quiz and worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 并记住,你会发现所有的词汇, 加上一个测验和工作表 在我们的网站,bbc学习英语.com。

sentences.en: But first, I have a question for you, Pippa.
sentences.zh: 但首先 我有一个问题要问你 皮帕

sentences.en: Just now, you used the phrase the positive power of poetry, repeating the same initial 'p' sound across a string of words.
sentences.zh: 刚才,你用了诗的正面力量, 重复了同一个开头的“p”声音 横跨一连串的词组。

sentences.en: Doing this is a common feature of poetry, but what's it called?
sentences.zh: 这样做是诗歌的一个共同特征, 但叫什么呢?

sentences.en: Is it: a) assonance, b) alliteration, or c) simile?
sentences.zh: 是:a) 感应,b) 感应,或c) 硅?

sentences.en: Hmm. Finally, my English degree might come in handy!
sentences.zh: 终于 我的英语学位可能有用了!

sentences.en: And I'm going to say b) alliteration. Well, we'll find out at the end, and I hope you don't get embarrassed, Pippa!
sentences.zh: 我们最后会知道的 希望你别尴尬 皮帕!

sentences.en: Now, poetry helped Maria overcome sadness, but could its power to heal work in other areas too?
sentences.zh: 现在,诗歌帮助玛丽亚克服了悲伤, 但它能治愈其他领域的工作吗?

sentences.en: Hot Poets is a group helping people understand the science behind global issues like climate change.
sentences.zh: 热诗组帮助人们了解气候变化等全球问题背后的科学。

sentences.en: They go to meetings like the UN Climate Conference and listen to scientific papers being presented.
sentences.zh: 他们参加联合国气候会议这样的会议,并听取提交的科学论文。

sentences.en: Then they write a poem about it all and perform that back to the audience.
sentences.zh: 然后他们写了一首关于这一切的诗 并将它还给观众。

sentences.en: Here's Hot Poet Liv Torc, reciting her poem to BBC World Service's People Fixing the World.
sentences.zh: 这是Hot Poet Liv Torc, 向BBC世界服务社的 修补世界的人朗诵她的诗。

sentences.en: It starts with an adventure at sea, A big blue murder mystery, where the killer is not the whale But an epic humanity fail Of overfishing and polluting at unimaginable scale.
sentences.zh: 它始于海上的探险, 一个巨大的蓝色谋杀谜, 杀手不是鲸鱼, 但它是一个史诗般的人性 失败过度捕捞和污染 以难以想象的规模。

sentences.en: Liv's poem is based on a study into biodiversity.
sentences.zh: Liv的诗是根据对生物多样性的研究写的

sentences.en: It's a complex research project that many find hard to understand.
sentences.zh: 这是一个复杂的研究项目, 许多人很难理解。

sentences.en: Here, Liv discusses this with Myra Anubi for BBC World Service programme People Fixing the World: And Liv, I mean, so what you've identified is that there is an issue around the communication of science.
sentences.zh: Liv在这里和Myra Anubi讨论这个问题, 英国广播公司世界服务节目《人们修补世界:Liv,我的意思是, 你所知道的是, 围绕科学的交流有一个问题。

sentences.en: Yes, a lot of this jargon is really hard to understand, or a lot of the science is quite impenetrable to normal people, so it's instantly a turn-off.
sentences.zh: 是的,很多这些术语很难理解, 或很多科学对正常人来说是相当不可阻挡的, 所以它立刻就关闭了。

sentences.en: Science uses lots of jargon – specialist or technical vocabulary which is quite different from everyday language.
sentences.zh: 科学使用许多与日常语言相当不同的术语 — — 专家或技术词汇。

sentences.en: For example, a scientist might use the word precipitation, while in everyday English we would say rain.
sentences.zh: 例如,科学家可能会使用降水一词,而在日常英语中,我们会说降雨。

sentences.en: Jargon can make scientific papers impenetrable, an adjective meaning impossible to understand.
sentences.zh: 贾贡可以使科学论文无法穿透, 这是一种无法理解的形容词含义。

sentences.en: And worse, it makes science a turn-off – something that people dislike or find uninteresting.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是,它使科学成为转折 — — 一种人们不喜欢或不感兴趣的东西。

sentences.en: Hot Poets try to change all of that by making complex environmental ideas easy to understand through poetry.
sentences.zh: 热诗人试图改变这一切 通过诗歌让复杂的环境观念 容易理解。

sentences.en: And it works, says Kat Bruce, the environmental scientist whose study Liv based her poem on, talking here with Myra Anubi for BBC World Service's People Fixing the World.
sentences.zh: Kat Bruce说, 环境科学家Liv研究的诗 与Myra Anubi在这里为BBC世界服务公司的人 修补世界。

sentences.en: What did it mean for you, Kat, hearing the poem, having actually experienced everything she's saying?
sentences.zh: 这对你意味着什么, Kat, 听到这首诗, 亲身体验她所说的一切?

sentences.en: It still gives me goosebumps when I hear it now.
sentences.zh: 当我现在听到它的时候,它仍然让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

sentences.en: I think it's everything that I wish I could say and put into words myself.
sentences.zh: 我想这是我想说的一切 并且用自己的话来说。

sentences.en: I feel like Liv just, you know, has done that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得Liv只是,你知道,已经做到了。

sentences.en: Liv's poem gave Kat goosebumps, meaning she was so emotionally affected that the hairs on her skin stood up, making tiny bumps.
sentences.zh: Liv的诗给了Kat okebumps, 意思是她很感情用事 以至于她皮肤上的毛都站起来了, 做了些小的肿块。

sentences.en: Maybe poetry can't fix everything, but for Kat, it's making an impact for good.
sentences.zh: 也许诗歌不能解决一切, 但对于Kat来说,它正在产生一线影响。

sentences.en: Now, what was the answer to your question, Neil?
sentences.zh: 你的问题的答案是什么 尼尔?

sentences.en: Well, you seemed very clear, Pippa, that when you use a string of words beginning with the same sound, it's called alliteration... and you're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 嗯,你似乎很清楚,皮帕, 当你用一连串的词 以同一个声音开始, 它叫"感应"...

sentences.en: Phew! OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with open mic night, a live event where anyone is allowed to perform poems or music on stage.
sentences.zh: 让我们回顾一下我们学到的词汇, 从开声麦克风之夜开始, 现场活动, 任何人都可以在舞台上表演诗歌或音乐。

sentences.en: If something touches your soul, it affects you deeply on an emotional or spiritual level.
sentences.zh: 如果有东西触动你的灵魂 就会在情感或精神上深深地影响你

sentences.en: Jargon means special words and phrases that are used in a particular profession or subject.
sentences.zh: jargon意指特定专业或学科中使用的特殊词语和短语。

sentences.en: The adjective impenetrable means impossible to understand.
sentences.zh: 这个形容词是无法理解的

sentences.en: A turn-off is something that people dislike or find uninteresting.
sentences.zh: 转弯是人们不喜欢或不感兴趣的东西

sentences.en: And finally, if you get goosebumps, the hairs on your skin stand up because you're cold, emotionally affected, or afraid.
sentences.zh: 最终,如果你得到 鹅窝,你的皮肤上的毛 站起来,因为你冷, 情感影响,或害怕。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up, but remember, you'll find lots more episodes as well as a quiz and worksheet for this one on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 再一次,我们的六分钟到了, 但是记住, 你会发现更多的片段 以及一个测试和工作表 在我们的网站上,bbc学习英语. com。

sentences.en: See you again soon. But for now, it's goodbye.
sentences.zh: 很快再见,但现在再见了

sentences.en: Goodbye!
sentences.zh: 再见!
